review.assessment: The change introduces a new `flatten` function in solution.mjs that attempts to flatten nested arrays recursively but fails because it lacks a base case or guard to stop recursion when the depth limit is reached. Consequently, the function ignores the specified depth and always flattens arrays completely regardless of the nesting level, leading to incorrect results for any input with deeper structures than the allowed depth.

findings.defect: The flatten function does not respect the depth limit and flattens all nested arrays completely.
